Garnering positive reviews and significant audience acclaim, the film has impressed influential figures in Tamil cinema. In just five days, it has remarkably surpassed sixty-five crore rupees globally, marking a monumental achievement for both the director and lead actor Soori.

items.title: Salman Khan gets aarti direction wrong, Arpita's quick correction wins hearts online
items.body: <![CDATA[Salman Khan celebrated Ganpati with his family, sharing a sweet sibling moment. His sister Arpita Khan Sharma guided him during the sacred aarti ritual. The candid video of this interaction quickly went viral across social media platforms. Salman Khan also attended the festivities with other family members and guests. The actor is currently hosting the latest season of Bigg Boss.

items.title: In the 1980s, Goldie Hawn and Kurt Russell built their dreamy Colorado ranch
items.body: <![CDATA[In the 1980s, Goldie Hawn and Kurt Russell established a picturesque ranch in Colorado, coinciding with Russell's career height. Spanning around seventy acres, the property has even welcomed Princess Diana and her children during their visit. The couple splits their time between this serene mountain retreat and their home in Los Angeles.

items.title: DEA searches Hayden Panettiere's LA home
items.body: <![CDATA[Federal drug agents searched Hayden Panettiere's Los Angeles residence after her passing. Investigators sought evidence linked to black-market controlled substances and potential fentanyl contamination. They reportedly examined prescription and recreational drugs found at the home for analysis. The DEA is tracing a suspected fatal pill back to an alleged drug dealer. Toxicology results are pending to determine the exact cause of her death.

items.title: Shah Rukh Khan reveals simple Ganpati celebrations at Mannat before visarjan today
items.body: <![CDATA[Shah Rukh Khan offered fans a warm glimpse into his family's Ganpati celebrations at Mannat, revealing that wife Gauri Khan leads the aarti and prayers while their children and friends gather for a relaxed family evening. The actor's post, shared alongside Ganesh Chaturthi wishes, once again highlighted how the Khan household blends Hindu and Muslim traditions with ease, a theme Shah Rukh has spoken about candidly in the past regarding his interfaith marriage and his children's upbringing.

items.title: SRK's Swades: Aamir was first choice; R Madhavan 'killed it' in audition
items.body: <![CDATA[Riddhima Kapoor Sahni expressed gratitude for another year of her life as she celebrated her birthday on September 15. She said she is stepping into a new chapter with faith and Lord Ganesha by her side.

items.title: Calvin Harris announces first Australian headline tour
items.body: <![CDATA[Calvin Harris, the Grammy-winning sensation, is set to grace Australia with his electrifying performances in February 2027. Kicking off in Perth on February 18, the tour will hit four major cities before wrapping up in Melbourne. Fans are urged to stay alert for pre-sale and general sale tickets. Look forward to his latest hits, including the infectious single 'Satisfy' and the captivating album 96 Months.

items.title: Biggest OTT platform rejected 'Hanuman Ansh,' says director on his 14 year struggle
items.body: <![CDATA[Hanuman Ansh has triumphed at the box office after an unsteady commencement, accumulating a staggering Rs 222 crore in domestic earnings. Director Vishal Chaturvedi persevered through numerous challenges during production, including the initial rejection of the film's concept by an OTT platform. This inspirational drama has emerged as one of the decade's financial successes.

items.title: Vimal, Shriya Saran’s ‘Sandakari’ promises romance, comedy and workplace drama
items.body: <![CDATA[After a long seven-year anticipation, the romantic comedy Sandakari, starring Vimal and Shriya Saran, is set to hit theaters. This delightful film, crafted within the vibrant ambience of a London software company, delves into the complexities of workplace relationships and budding romances between its main characters. Sandakari is the Tamil rendition of Jeethu Joseph's acclaimed Malayalam film My Boss, and will be available in cinemas starting September 18.

items.title: Drake reveals that he is going on tour soon
items.body: <![CDATA[In a thrilling announcement, Drake has revealed that he will be embarking on a world tour in 2027. This comes after the release of his innovative visual project FOMO, funded entirely by himself. Following the conclusion of his previous tour, It's All a Blur, in April 2024, fans are buzzing with curiosity about tour details and what unique surprises may lie ahead.

items.title: Veteran actress Disco Shanti’s hospital photo leaves fans worried
items.body: <![CDATA[Veteran actress Disco Shanti has concerned fans after sharing a hospital photo. She posted an update indicating her return home from the medical facility. This health news comes as she prepares for a film comeback after many years. Disco Shanti was a popular star in Tamil cinema during the 1980s and 1990s. Her son Meghamsh Srihari is also pursuing a career in Telugu cinema.

items.title: Kunal Kemmu & Preity Zinta's 'VIBE' gets 'A' certificate from CBFC
items.body: <![CDATA[Kunal Kemmu and Preity G Zinta’s upcoming action comedy, 'VIBE' has received an ‘A’ certificate from the CBFC ahead of its September 18 theatrical release. According to Bollywood Hungama, the Examining Committee ordered no visual cuts and left the film’s romantic and violent sequences untouched. The makers were asked to mute one profanity and add an anti-drug disclaimer. The film has a certified runtime of 145.55 minutes, or 2 hours 25 minutes and 55 seconds.

items.title: ‘The Paradise’: Choreographers praise Nani’s dedication to physically demanding action sequences
items.body: <![CDATA[Actor Nani is preparing for his role in the upcoming action thriller film 'The Paradise'. Stunt choreographers Ram and Lakshman praised Nani's commitment to difficult fight scenes. Nani performed many physically demanding stunts himself and insisted on additional takes. He also actively participated in planning and preparing the action sequences. The film, featuring Nani's new look, releases on September 24.

items.title: Motivational quote by Elton John
items.body: <![CDATA[Elton John emphasizes the importance of perseverance in the music industry, offering simple yet profound advice to new musicians. He reflects on his own early challenges with Bluesology, highlighting that overcoming struggles fosters a deeper appreciation for success. Trusting one's own abilities and staying authentic in the face of obstacles are keys to personal growth and artistic integrity.

items.title: Alia recalls theatrical father: Actress shares grizzly bear-like memory
items.body: <![CDATA[Alia Bhatt shared a childhood memory of her father Mahesh Bhatt, recalling his theatrical personality after a special screening of Om Ka Hari, starring her mother Soni Razdan. She described how he dramatically helped her memorize the spelling of "the" during a Class 1 test, calling him a "highly theatrical" grizzly bear.

items.title: Vijay Sethupathi’s 'Baththa' teaser unveils actor’s intriguing retro look
items.body: <![CDATA[Vijay Sethupathi takes center stage in the forthcoming period drama 'Baththa', with its newly unveiled teaser showcasing a nostalgic retro ambiance. Marking the third collaboration between the acclaimed actor and director Balaji Tharaneetharan, the film promises a poignant father-daughter tale enhanced by Sai Abhyankkar's stirring soundtrack. Fans can expect its theatrical debut on October 1, 2026.

items.title: Tory Lanez announces concert dates while incarcerated
items.body: <![CDATA[Beginning September 25 and continuing through November, Tory Lanez will hold music listening events all over the United States. Currently serving time for a 2020 shooting, Lanez remains committed to his music, having released a double album from prison earlier this year. This initiative reflects his unwavering passion for his craft, regardless of his circumstances.

items.title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' BO Day 13 [LIVE]: Pankaj Tripathi film chases Rs 200 crore
items.body: <![CDATA['Mirzapur The Movie' has crossed the Rs. 196 crore mark in India as it enters Day 13, putting the coveted Rs. 200 crore domestic milestone firmly within reach. The Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan starrer has settled into a slow, steady weekday pace in its third week of release, with its worldwide gross already past Rs. 281 crore. With the film now closing in on the Rs. 200 crore club, the coming days will reveal just how much more mileage it has left in theatres.
